utility.notes: Crescent City and Del Norte County are confirmed to be served by Pacific Power (PacifiCorp), not PG&E — independently checked rather than assumed, since PG&E's own service-area documentation does not include this area (PG&E's territory ends south of Del Norte County). This is a notable exception among this dataset's far-Northern-California cities, most of which are PG&E territory.

generation_supplier.notes: Redwood Coast Energy Authority (RCEA), the CCA serving most of neighboring Humboldt County, does not serve Del Norte County — RCEA's own confirmed member-jurisdiction list is limited to Humboldt County entities. No separate CCA was found serving Crescent City this session.

value.name: Checklist of all requirements, adopted by the building official and published on the City's website, may reference the California Solar Permitting Guidebook
4 complete sets of construction plans, drawn to scale with professional seals
4 copies of Title 24 energy compliance calculations
Proof of ownership and current assessor's parcel map

required_documents.notes: Per Crescent City Municipal Code Section 15.40.030: the building official adopts a checklist of all requirements, published on the City's website, which may reference the CA Solar Permitting Guidebook. Combined with the city's general building-permit submittal list (S1).

value: Only one inspection may be required, done in a timely manner, and may include a consolidated inspection by the building official and fire chief
If a system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is authorized
inspection_steps.notes: Per Crescent City Municipal Code Section 15.40.030.

timeline_days.notes: Crescent City Municipal Code Section 15.40.060(B) states a complete application 'will be promptly processed' and the building official shall approve and issue permits — no explicit day-count figure.

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited, streamlined permitting process for small residential rooftop solar energy systems (Crescent City Municipal Code Chapter 15.40)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Solar panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the authority having jurisdiction
